notes.title: Update Notes for July 11th
notes.notes:
Updated translations for Japanese, Portuguese, Korean, Turkish, Czech, Polish, Hungarian, Russian, & Dutch.
Automated crowdin downloader.
Added dirty flag tracking for FileBasedPrefs.
Fixed NullReferenceException in Legend.Minion.

notes.title: Dragon Forge Release Date - July 8th, 2022
notes.notes:
RELEASE DATE
We are extremely pleased to announce the release date of Legend Studios newest game, Dragon Forge!

Dragon Forge will be available through Steam on July 8th, 2022.

Visit our steam page for more information, screenshots, and gameplay where you can also Wishlist Now!

DRAGON FORGE
Become a powerful dragon & automate massive factories! Dragon Forge is an incremental base building adventure game. Uncurse & explore a huge fantasy world full of quests. Gather resources & craft upgrades to become unstoppable! Discover over 100 fables of ancient wisdom at the Dragon Forge.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1163930/extras/Respawn_Sequence_2_3.gif

DEMO
A fifteen minute demo of the game is available Now through June 20th where we give you the opportunity to play the game for free and get a sneak peek at what the game has to offer.

We will also be hosting dev streams as part of the Steam Next Fest next week.

About Legend Studio
Founded in 1992, Legend Studio is an independent game developer, creating games such as Dragon Forge, Never Split the Party, A Legend of Luca VR, and FreeCell Quest.
